summary: Named as a tower in Bryan County on a 2016 Google-map Georgia lookout list; no source gives its build date or describes the site today.

facts.status_note: No source says whether this tower stands today.

evidence.supports: Tower called richmond hill, in Bryan County, on the list
Elevation of 18 with no unit stated; no register number
The list is a Google map revised in 2016

notes_for_editor: Only one source: a single line in a Google-map Georgia lookout list (tnlandforms.us, revised 2016). The elevation column (18) has no unit stated; the brief's 5.5 m assumes feet. The brief's record (coordinates, county, elevation, no registers) matches that line. The Eastern U.S. Lookouts Georgia directory and the NHLR Georgia index have no Richmond Hill tower. The Eastern U.S. Lookouts Richmond Hill page is a Massachusetts tower and is not this one. Two web searches turned up nothing about this tower. Build date, design, staffing, access and site status are all unknown. The story is about 90 words, below the 120-word target, because the evidence is one line; it has not been padded.
